mapper.select: SELECT r.*, d.name AS device_name, d.device_no, u.real_name AS inspector_name FROM inspection_record r LEFT JOIN device d ON r.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN user u ON r.inspector_id = u.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inspection_record (plan_id, device_id, inspector_id, result, description, photo_name, inspect_time, create_time) VALUES (#{planId}, #{deviceId}, #{inspectorId}, #{result}, #{description}, #{photoName}, #{inspectTime}, NOW())
